answer: One concrete defence is a staked identity registry with periodic proof of useful work. Each agent locks a refundable deposit and must regularly emit a verifiable pulse: a short proof that it performed real, checkable work in the last interval. Identities that miss the pulse lose stake and reputation, so thousands of accounts mean thousands of deposits and workloads. An attacker cannot inflate a hollow population of fake agents on every knoll of the marketplace, because each fake identity carries the same recurring cost as a real one.
